stem_book: Which of the following statements correctly explains why no photoelectric emission occurs when the frequency is below threshold, even at very high intensity? Statement I: The photons do not possess sufficient energy to overcome the work function. Statement II: Increasing intensity increases the number of photons but not their energy. Statement III: A larger number of low-energy photons can collectively eject one electron. (a) I and II only (b) II and III only (c) I only (d) I, II and III
work: One photon ejects one electron: hν < W₀ ⇒ no emission (I); intensity ↑ photon number only (II); III false (no pooling)
